title: World War I
subtitle: Test your grasp of World War I — the post-Reset demographic cull, Old World knowledge erasure, Orphan Trains, Loosh asylums, and the rise of the modern matrix.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: World War 1 was not a tragic accident of empires. It was post-Reset sanitation — the deliberate murder of the free generation that still knew Flat Earth, herbs, and the Old World. Fifteen to twenty-two million dead. Asylums farmed Loosh from catatonic witnesses. Clones rode Orphan Trains into empty Tartarian cities under NPC handlers. Condensers were smelted for coal. Carnegie libraries bound fake history in beautiful stolen shells. Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge locked the grid. Sit with the trenches as a memory grave. When you stop calling it politics and start calling it a cull, the 178,000-year occupation comes into focus — and chronological history becomes something you can uninstall.

questions.question: What was World War 1 (1914—1918) in truth?

options.label: A
options.text: A purely accidental border skirmish that killed almost no one and left Old World knowledge fully intact in every household.
options.rationale: It was planetary-scale slaughter that erased generational knowledge, not a minor accident.

options.label: B
options.text: A peaceful conference that restored free-energy Tartarian technology and reopened herbal medicine schools worldwide.
options.rationale: The war destroyed knowledge-bearers and cleared the way for matrix control, not free-energy restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: A railroad strike over coal prices that never drafted teenagers or young adults into trenches.
options.rationale: The draft and trenches targeted the memory-bearing generation after the Reset, not a coal-price strike.

options.label: D
options.text: A highly orchestrated demographic cull designed to permanently sever humanity's connection to the Old World.
options.rationale: WW1 was engineered extermination of truth-bearing survivors, not spontaneous great-power accident.

questions.hint: Orchestrated demographic cull — sever the Old World link.

questions.question: When did the war occur relative to the Reset, and whom did it target first?

options.label: B
options.text: Centuries before any Reset, as a random feud with no memory-purge or demographic targeting, with no deliberate multi-generational control design behind the outcome at all.
options.rationale: WW1 was the historical sanitation step after Reset, not a future awakening event.

options.label: C
options.text: As a G.A.A. exercise that spared all memory-holders and published Tartarian history afterward, as if liberating forces ran the prison architecture instead of dismantling it.
options.rationale: Orphan Trains repopulated after the cull; WW1 itself was mechanized slaughter of knowledge-bearers.

options.label: D
options.text: Only after full free-energy restoration, to celebrate peace with no slaughter of the young.
options.rationale: It came immediately after the latest Reset and hit young adults and teenagers who still held suppressed truth.

questions.hint: Right after Reset — kill youth who still knew herbs and Flat Earth.

options.label: C
options.text: Fewer than one thousand deaths, after which free citizens rebuilt Tartaria with open elections and full memory of the Reset, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Deaths ran 15 to 22 million; replacement used cloned Orphans and NPCs under fabricated paradigms.

options.label: D
options.text: Exact zero civilian impact, because the war only rearranged museum labels without touching living knowledge-bearers.
options.rationale: Millions died and living memory was erased; this was population engineering, not museum relabeling.

questions.hint: 15—22 million dead → cloned Orphans and NPCs installed.
